kits.notes: Shirt white, agreed by The Celtic Wiki (white top, green collar, red-and-green Celtic cross) and Wikipedia (white top, Marist Brothers' cross badge); green is the collar (The Celtic Wiki). Wikipedia alone gives black shorts and black-and-green hooped socks: one publisher, not set.
Green and white hoops from 1903, agreed by The Celtic Star (horizontal green and white stripes, most likely first worn 29 August 1903) and Wikipedia. Shorts and socks not stated by either for 1903.
